<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
In a World of Warcraft guild you add your own characters, and Alagos signs you up with the right one.

## Add your character

Open `/my-profile`, then the WoW tab, then **👤 My characters** and **➕ Add my character**. Give:

- its **name** and **realm**, as they are in the game;
- its **class**;
- its **item level** and a **logs link** (Warcraft Logs), if you like. Both are optional.

Your first character is your **main**. Add your alts the same way, up to 10.

## Choose your specs

Open the character in **👤 My characters** and pick your **main spec** and, if you play one, your **off-spec**. The menus only show your class's specs. If you change class, a spec that no longer fits is cleared.

Press **✏️ Edit** to add your **talent build**: paste your talent string or a build link (Wowhead, Raidbots), so your officers can see how you play.

## Sign up for a raid

Press the button for the role you want to play, such as **Healer**. Alagos picks your spec for it:

1. your main spec, if it plays that role;
2. else your off-spec;
3. else another spec of your class.

It looks at your main character first, then your alts. The post shows you with your spec, like **Nestaron · Holy Paladin**.

In the answer only you see, you can **switch spec** or **character**. Your off-spec's role is your **second choice**, used when your role is full and that one has room. If your role is full you go on its **bench** and move up by yourself; Alagos tells you in a DM.

If none of your characters can play that role, Alagos says so. Press another role, or add a character that can.
{% endraw %}
